tests/research/test_causal_graph.py — MEASURED 2026-09-09 on a planted shared driver: conditioning leaves 5% of the unconditioned MI (0.0245 of 0.4578 nats), while a genuine mechanism on the same driver keeps 23% (0.1771 of 0.7754) and is ~7x the driver's CMI; both return p=0.005, so again only the magnitude separates them (MEASURED)

tests/research/test_causal_graph.py — the nonlinear conditional REFUSES below its stated floor (1,280 aligned bars for one admitted parent at four bins, against MIN_N=500) rather than answering from too few cells, which is why it annotates the linear test and does not replace it (MEASURED)
items.note: DEMOTED 2026-09-09 on an external audit that was right, and closed the same day. The audit's finding was exact: Granger-style incremental information, lagged cross-correlation, state dependence and bootstrap/permutation machinery all existed, and every one of them is LINEAR OR MONOTONE, while a grep for transfer entropy or conditional mutual information across libs/ and desks/ returned one hit -- a field NAME in alpha_recombination.py with no implementation behind it. Both estimators now exist, are tested against generators whose answer is known before they run, and are read on every edge the hourly leg measures. They admit nothing: the admission rule is the deflated interval plus the incremental test, and a second gate here would change what the graph admits without anyone deciding to. The honest limit is stated in the module and pinned by a test: the p-value does NOT separate a mechanism from a shared driver -- both return p=0.005 under the within-Z null -- only the magnitude against the unconditioned MI does. ROUND 3 ADDED THE CONFOUNDER-AWARE HALF. Transfer entropy conditions on the TARGET'S OWN history; the audit was right that the target's other admitted parents were still handled only by the regression-based conditional_information. Nonlinear I(X;Y | other admitted parents of Y) is now computed beside that deltaR2, on the same sample and the same lags, and it is annotation-only exactly as TE is: the conditional STATUS remains the deltaR2's.

status_vocabulary_note: LANDED means the code exists in THIS REPOSITORY, on a named clock, with an artifact and a consumer. It does NOT mean the artifact has ever been produced on the trading box, and it does not mean the behaviour has been observed with money at risk. That distinction is what the five acceptance_properties measure, and they are measured from artifacts rather than asserted: an absent artifact reads UNMEASURED, never MET. Read the census as build coverage and the acceptance properties as operational proof. They are different questions and the second is the one that decides whether the desk works.
